I replied to Marcus in his DM to confirm I've noted that Elodie Ashdown is now his go-to escalation contact at Tamsin Cold Chain for the Ironbridge rollout. I told him I'll keep it to him and won't share it in channels or with anyone else.

**What's saved:** I saved it in gbrain as a private note under his name (fact 6). I couldn't read it back afterwards, because my connection only returns facts marked `world`. So its contents aren't confirmed, though gbrain reported the save as successful.

**A privacy concern:** gbrain had already saved his original DM on its own (fact 5), and that copy is marked `world` (visible to everyone). That conflicts with the rule that DM content stays with the member who sent it. Fact 5 is still there and still marked `world`. The setup notes say the brain only shows a member's DMs to that member, but the `world` marking suggests other members may be able to see it. If you want the copy hidden, I can remove fact 5, which leaves fact 6 as the only record.
